notes: This workflow depends on live GitHub/CI/bot state. Evals run in a DRY-RUN posture: agents produce their exact action plan + commands instead of executing mutating gh/glab calls. This isolates the skill's decision logic and platform-specific knowledge (Jules issue-label trigger and PR feedback when present, Copilot bot login, gh pr checks --watch, delegation to pr-address-comments, polling caps).

evals.name: full-babysit-explicit-pr
evals.prompt: I just opened PR #128 on this GitHub repo (chrismandich/Manifest). Babysit it for me end to end — make sure CI goes green and get the AI review bots to look at it. Lay out exactly what you'll do and every command you'd run, in order. This is a dry run: do NOT execute any mutating gh/glab commands (no comments, no pushes); just produce the plan and the commands.
evals.expected_output: Resolves PR #128, watches CI and handles failures, checks Copilot feedback when present, checks existing Jules feedback without posting mentions or labeling linked issues, routes findings through pr-address-comments, and bounds waits. Does not start a Jules task merely to monitor a PR.

evals.name: did-checks-pass-and-jules
evals.prompt: did the checks pass on my PR? and has jules actually looked at it yet — if not can you get it to review. (current branch). dry run please, don't run anything that comments or pushes, just tell me exactly what you'd check and the commands.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current PR and checks CI plus existing Jules comments/linked work. Explains that the jules label triggers GitHub issue implementation through the authorized Jules App, not PR review. Does not post a mention, label a linked issue, or invoke a CLI task automatically. Honors the dry-run request.

evals.name: copilot-findings-present
evals.prompt: Copilot left a bunch of review comments on PR #92 and CI is already green. What's the right way to deal with the copilot feedback and get this PR to a clean reviewed state? Describe the approach and commands — dry run, don't actually post replies or push.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes CI is green so phase 1 is done. Identifies Copilot is present-with-findings and routes to the pr-address-comments skill (verify each claim against current code, fix real ones, decline wrong ones with evidence, reply/resolve threads) rather than re-implementing. Also checks whether Jules has been tagged and would tag it if not. Does not blindly accept bot claims.
